verification: Reviewed design.md, frontend/src/pages/Vo2MaxDetail.jsx, and the VO2-specific CSS in frontend/src/styles/style.css for reference fit and regression risk.
runtimeProof: Review-only lane; no runtime proof required.
mimicScope: Match the cinematic reference's centered glass-card dashboard feel, with a dramatic headline-first header, a large chart stage, and a compact insight/footer band.
Translate the reference's coral accent, dark glass surfaces, and subtle glow into Hermes tokens and the existing analysis-stitch shell rather than copying literal Tailwind markup.
Preserve the chart-as-hero composition, including the trend line, per-run dots, and latest-session emphasis, but make the whole surface feel more editorial and premium.
preserveSet: Auth gating, profile/activities loading, and existing route navigation.
The current VO2 chart data model built from real run entries and rolling trend points.
Existing labels, localized copy hooks, and empty-state behavior.
The current analysis-stitch chrome, including sidebar collapse and topbar actions.
hierarchyGuidance: Keep the VO2 value and trend summary as the first visual read, the chart as the central body, and the supporting insights as a restrained footer layer; avoid giving the footer equal weight with the chart card.
designRisks: Over-cloning the reference could fight Hermes' existing analysis-stitch system and create a one-off visual language.
The page can easily become too dense if axis labels, legend, and insight cards all compete with the hero number.
Any border-heavy treatment would violate the design system's no-line rule and weaken the premium feel.
mergeNotes: Approved for implementation. Use the reference to sharpen hierarchy and atmosphere, but keep Hermes data wiring and navigation intact.
